purpose: Preregistered real-tool coding-agent comparison: baseline vs full GodPrompt vs minimal verify-only GodPrompt. Study is exploratory: genuine but previously examined owner-reported issues.

tasks.description: Implement opt-in rss-compare --show-retitles (off by default), including compare_saved_rss_headlines(..., show_retitles=False). With flag, JSON adds retitled_urls only for shared exact URLs whose first-seen title differs, entries with url, older_title, newer_title; Markdown includes a readable escaped older/newer title table. Without flag preserve existing JSON/Markdown/CSV bytes; CSV remains unchanged even with flag. Preserve existing counts, duplicate/missing-metadata review exit codes, offline provider-free behavior, no-overwrite guarantees and evidence provenance. Add scoped regression tests.

Implement opt-in rss-compare --sort-url (off by default), including compare_saved_rss_headlines(..., sort_url=False). When true sort each newly_seen, still_seen, not_seen_in_newer list by exact URL consistently in JSON/CSV/Markdown; changes in source row order must not change sorted output. Without flag preserve all existing output bytes, membership, counts, duplicates/missing-metadata review exit 2, CSV formula and Markdown escaping, no-overwrite, and offline evidence caveats. Add scoped regression tests.

limitations: Both user-owned public issues were examined in V9/V10; no unseen-task or population-level causal claim.
Behavioral grader was calibrated by the same investigation team, independent blinded adjudication not provided.
V13 uses one independent reference patch for #410 and two historical model-produced patches for #408.
Model identity, effective effort, Windows host policy and same-user private grader isolation cannot be independently attested.
Token metrics are model-reported (some cached), not independently billed cost.
